description:
Replication package for Effective Training Pressure Gates Recursive Knowledge Degradation in LLMs: A Multi-Axis Dose-Response Study.

Contents: (i) consolidated per-seed results files, one JSON per seed per arm, covering experiments G1 to G5, B7 and G2; (ii) training configuration files for every reported condition; (iii) the evaluation protocol, question partition identifiers, and the K0 baseline sets for all three backbones; and (iv) new in v1.0.4, the analysis and table-generation script, the figure-generation scripts, and the audit scripts.

Raw token-level predictions, trained adapter checkpoints and base-model weights are not included: the first two exceed practical size limits for data repositories, and base-model weights are not redistributed under their respective licenses. Base-model checkpoint SHA-1 hashes sufficient to retrieve identical weights are listed in supplementary Table S1 of the article.
